newsitem.title: USA: Planet Hollywood proceeding with Marvel.
newsitem.headline: Planet Hollywood proceeding with Marvel.

text.p: Planet Hollywood International Inc's President and Chief Executive Robert Earl, speaking at a Montgomery Securities Hospitality Conference, said he was comfortable with analysts' forecasts for the fouth quarter and the year.
First Call consensus estimates for the fourth quarter are $0.13 per share and $0.46 for the year. Montgomery Securities research estimates 1996 EPS at $0.45 per share.

Earl also said the company was going ahead with its agreement with Marvel Entertainment Group Inc to develop comic book-theme restaurants and will open the first in Los Angeles by the end of the year.
The progress of the deal has been in question since Marvel filed for Chapter 11 in December.
Earl said Marvel had received financing to go ahead with the restaurant chain and added that Planet Hollywood was "modifying the deal as we speak to satisfy us."

Earl declined to comment on the impact of a possible merger between Hilton Hotels Corp and ITT Corp on the company's agreement with ITT for two gaming resorts, but said, "we're confident that there will be a Planet Hollywood in Law Vegas on that 34 acre site." The two Planet Hollywood casino hotels are planned in Las Vegas and Atlantic City, N.J.

Earl told analysts the company would continue to leverage the strength of existing brands and introduce new brand concepts to fuel long-term growth. The company had fixed on a site for its first music-themed restaurant concept at the old Paramount Theater in New York City.
The company expects to release earnings late next Tuesday.
